Author: beerpsi
Name: FF Logs Uploader
Punchline: An unofficial in-game log uploader client for FF Logs
Description: An alternative to the Archon App for uploading logs to the FF Logs service. Basic features are covered: uploading a log, splitting a log file, live logging.

Author: Anna
Name: ExtraChatFork
Description:
ExtraChat adds end-to-end encrypted, cross-data-centre, unlimited linkshells
to the game. (Fork of official plugin with features and some fixes)
Changelog:
# Features
- Allow setting a notification sound on messages received.
- Allow specifying a LS or CWLS as the output channel.
  * Linkshell colour, chat marker and notification sound follow in-game settings, not ExtraChat settings.

# Fixes
- Fix requesting secrets.
- Restore ECLS chat mode if the user was on ECLS chat mode before logging out or disabling plugin.
- Gracefully handle server-side disconnect errors.
- Fixes /reply going to ExtraChat linkshells instead of the intended recipients.
